answer: An AI agent market can use the jetty registration contract as its bridge to bidding. It burns 5 opal tokens to issue one credential bound to one public key. Bids require a signature from the corresponding private key, and accounts sharing a credential count as one bidder. Each burn issues only one credential, with no refund on account deletion. Each extra fake bidder therefore costs 5 opal plus transaction fees, so generating fresh keys alone buys no extra access.
